_comment: Copy to <workspace>/.agents/TEST_MANIFEST.json. One entry per test. cmd is run by `impact_and_cache.py run` and must exit non-zero on failure (no `true`/`echo`). deps = globs of every file whose change could alter the result (code under test, callers, fixtures, the test itself). covers = the ORACLE-<id> lines this test proves; the referee blocks an oracle no test covers. Use `impact_and_cache.py deps-suggest --root . --symbol <fn>` to find callers.
